name: php_Using_Components_with_Known_Vulnerabilities_Log4j
Description: Detects usage of known vulnerable components like log4j 2.x (CVE-2021-44228) via shell commands.

name: php_Using_Components_with_Known_Vulnerabilities_PDO
Description: Detects potential SQL injection due to outdated or vulnerable PDO drivers with improper input filtering.

name: php_Using_Components_with_Known_Vulnerabilities_Unserialize
Description: Detects unsafe deserialization with known vulnerable libraries (e.g., glibc CVE-2015-0235).

name: php_Using_Components_with_Known_Vulnerabilities_Smarty
Description: Detects usage of outdated Smarty template engine versions that may lack auto-escaping for XSS.
